annotations.text:
Slices 1-3 only.

There is no AI anywhere in these five screens. Whose-turn, warmth and next-touch are all plain computation — the point being that the app is already useful before the AI shows up in slice 4.

Dense on purpose: ~15 one-line rows at 38px.

The detail page can be airy; this one is a scanning task, so it trades spacing for rows-per-screen. Sort is whose-turn by default — that default is the product.

The stat strip is the warmth score with its signals beside it — never the number alone.

The values are set at 21px rather than 30px on purpose. These are inferences drawn from a mailbox, not invoice totals, and they shouldn't carry the typographic confidence of a fact.
